column3: With respect to the 535 & 545 5th Avenue Mortgage Loan (3.7%), a number of employees at the Mortgaged Property are covered by a collective bargaining agreement. In addition, employees at the Mortgaged Property participate in a multiemployer pension plan. To the extent the plan is underfunded, ERISA may subject the borrower to substantial liabilities under the plan if the borrower or other applicable party withdraws from the plan or the plan is terminated or experiences a mass withdrawal.
